Maya: Thinking out loud — can we add a 'cumulative metric gate' for runtime config changes? The idea: a config change (flag/quota/routing) only fully flips if a monitored metric's cumulative delta over a window stays within an accept threshold. Less flappy than instant rollbacks.

Tariq: Sounds promising. How do you define 'cumulative delta'? sum of deviations? moving average? :thinking_face:

Maya: Good q. My rough: compute percent-change relative to baseline over the window (e.g., 24h). If it stays <= +0.5% for error_rate and latency P95 doesn't move > +3% then mark gate ✅. Otherwise fail & optionally rollback.

Sam: Two practical asks: 1) telemetry lag — we need to account for delayed metrics ingestion, 2) noisy low-traffic tenants might produce high variance. We should tie gate windows to traffic volume thresholds. :eyes:

Dalia: From Console UX POV — we should expose: summary line (pass/fail), the metric chart with baseline overlay, and a tiny 'what changed' diff. Also a preview button that simulates effective routing before applying. Example mock: [Console] Gate: Cumulative 24h | Status: pending | Preview -> runs replay for 1h of traffic.

Maya: Exactly. Also want an API for programmatic rollouts. Draft payload:```json
POST /api/v1/config/apply
{
  "change": { "flag": "route_by_cost", "value": "opt-in" },
  "gate": { "type": "cumulative_metric", "metrics": ["error_rate","p95_latency"], "window": "24h", "thresholds": { "error_rate": 0.005, "p95_latency": 0.03 }, "min_traffic": 10000 }
}
```

Tariq: If gate fails, do we auto-rollback or just pause and notify? I worry about oscillations if teams re-try immediately. Suggest auto-pause + cooldown window + require manual override after N fails.

Sam: Agree. + add an optional 'dry_run_sample' param that runs the change for X% of traffic in shadow mode and computes the gate metric without impacting production. Example CLI:```bash
rictl config simulate --change route_by_cost=opt-in --sample 0.02 --window 1h
# outputs: simulated metrics, pass/fail, confidence intervals
```

Dalia: For the Console, default presets: 'safest' = 48h, error_rate 0.25% threshold, p95 2% threshold; 'fast' = 6h, error_rate 0.5%, p95 5%. Show an override flow: request approval -> audit log -> apply.

ops-bot: scheduled canary: config-candidate-2026-03-22 queued on dedicated pool — will start shadow-sim at 1769999998.

deploy-bot: deploy status: simulation-runner v2.3 - started (job id: sim-7721).

Tariq: One more: wanting historical replay for the preview is great, but we must cap replay costs (and make it tenant-scoped). Maybe limit to 6h historical replay in-console unless user has 'replay-power' role.

Maya: Next steps I propose: 1) write short RFC describing API shape + gate semantics, 2) telemetry team to propose exact metric aggregation (cumulative vs avg vs median), 3) UX mock for the console preview + approval flow, 4) implement a dry-run/simulate API and hook to simulation-runner. Anyone want to own the RFC? :raised_hands:

Sam: I can draft the RFC. Will include sample queries for BigQuery and pseudocode for the aggregation.

Dalia: I’ll put together Console mockups and the approval flow copy.

Maya: Great — thanks. Sam, Dalia, can you sync for 30m tomorrow? I’ll add an RFC checklist in the doc. :thumbsup:
